changelog: Aura AI v2.1.0 Images Gallery Screen & Complete Interactive Customization Suite
Connected Images Gallery: 2-column responsive grid indexing all chat-generated and local Aura images, with tap-to-enlarge, full view dialog, and 1-tap download
Pixel-Perfect Customization Badges: 36dp circular pastel badges for Personality, Memory, Plugins, Email, Calendar, Contacts, Passwords, and Location with zero icon cutoff
Interactive Personality Setup: 4 Assistant Tone presets (Jarvis, Professional, Friendly, Direct) and custom system instructions
Personal Memory Management: Add, review, and clear remembered facts and preferences across conversations
Jarvis Voice Contacts Book: Add and manage primary contacts with relationship tags for voice calling and messaging
Secure Credentials Vault: Store API keys and credentials with masked view, reveal toggle, and instant copy
Location & Email Preferences: Configure home/work commute addresses, real-time GPS toggle, and email digests
